a radio resource allocation framework for heterogeneous networks with relay nodes (RN) is proposed.
the optimal resource allocation in heterogeneous networks with RN depends on the backhaul capacity of RN and the number of UEs associated with RN.
we propose a resource allocation framework for heterogeneous cellular networks that includes relays and derive a resource allocation scheme that achieves proportional fairness among UEs.

RRM in heterogeneous networks with RN.
a fundamental RRM problem in heterogeneous networks with RN.
the RRM in heterogeneous networks with RN.

the paper provides a good analysis of the radio resource allocation problem in a heterogeneous network with relays.
the proposed framework can be implemented in heterogeneous networks with RN and the proposed resource allocation scheme can be used for the design of practical heterogeneous networks with RN.
the resource allocation problem is a non-convex problem and the proposed algorithm converges to the global solution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RN can be viewed as a micro BS with the capability to perform RRM, and the resource allocation in the RN can be performed in a similar way as in the BS.
we propose a new framework for RRM in heterogeneous networks with RN, which is different from existing works on RNs.

the resource allocation for heterogeneous network with relays should be done jointly at both the macro BS and the RNs, which is different from the conventional RRM in homogeneous networks where the RRM can be performed at the macro BS alone.

RNs should be deployed in a way to balance the load between the RN and the BS.
the resource allocation scheme for RNs is different from the conventional BSs.
